title: Term Life Insurance Conversion Credit Schedule
content:
**Term Life Insurance — conversion credit percentages.** The conversion credit is a share of the term policy's first-year annual premium (the policy fee excluded) credited toward the new permanent policy's first-year premium.

| Tier | Credit share | Earliest policy year earning credit | Latest policy year earning credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term | 0.00 (no credit) | 2 | 5 |
| Ashgrove Level Term 10 | 0.00 (no credit) | 2 | 5 |
| Ashgrove Level Term 15 | 0.50 (50%) | 2 | 5 |
| Ashgrove Level Term 20 | 1.00 (100%) | 2 | 5 |
| Ashgrove Level Term 25 | 1.00 (100%) | 2 | 5 |
| Ashgrove Level Term 30 | 1.00 (100%) | 2 | 5 |

Reading the schedule (hypothetical): an Ashgrove Level Term 15 converted in policy year 3 falls inside years 2 through 5 and its share is 50%; the same policy converted in policy year 1 or policy year 6 falls outside the years and earns no credit. On the Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term and the Ashgrove Level Term 10 the share is nil in every year.
